title: Strumming thin air: why grown-ups fly to Finland to play guitars that do not exist

sents.en: Every summer, a small city near the Arctic Circle hosts a contest in which the instruments are invisible and the stakes are, by design, very low.
sents.zh: 每年夏天，北极圈附近的一座小城都会举办一场比赛：乐器是隐形的，输赢也被刻意设计得无关紧要。

sents.en: Yet the event takes its silliness very seriously, and that may be the secret of its charm.
sents.zh: 可这个活动对自己的傻气却极其认真，而这也许正是它的魅力所在。

sents.en: Picture a stage, a roaring crowd and a performer in leather trousers, eyes shut, fingers flying across a guitar that is not there.
sents.zh: 想象一个舞台、一群欢呼的观众，还有一位穿皮裤的表演者：双眼紧闭，手指在一把并不存在的吉他上飞舞。

sents.en: For 60 seconds he leaps, kneels and pulls faces to a song he did not choose, then bows as if he had just played a sold-out stadium.
sents.zh: 整整 60 秒，他跟着一首不是自己选的歌又跳又跪、挤眉弄眼，然后鞠躬谢幕，仿佛刚在座无虚席的体育场开完演唱会。

sents.en: This is the Air Guitar World Championships, held in Oulu, Finland, since 1996.
sents.zh: 这就是空气吉他世界锦标赛，自 1996 年起在芬兰的奥卢举办。

sents.en: What began as a joke at a local music festival has grown into an international fixture, with national champions from dozens of countries competing for the title.
sents.zh: 它起初只是当地音乐节上的一个玩笑，如今已成为固定的国际赛事，几十个国家的全国冠军都来争夺这个头衔。

sents.en: The rules are short and strict.
sents.zh: 规则很短，也很严格。

sents.en: Contestants may not touch a real instrument, nor may they rely on backing musicians; the guitar must be entirely imaginary.
sents.zh: 选手不许碰真乐器，也不许靠伴奏乐手；吉他必须完全是想象出来的。

sents.en: Judges score each performance on technical skill, stage presence and a hard-to-define quality the organisers call 'airness'.
sents.zh: 评委按技术、台风，以及一种主办方称为“空气感”、很难说清的特质给每场表演打分。

sents.en: A good air guitarist, in other words, must convince the audience that the music is coming from his fingers, not the speakers.
sents.zh: 换句话说，一位优秀的空气吉他手必须让观众相信：音乐来自他的手指，而不是音箱。

sents.en: Mistakes are allowed, but only if they are made with conviction.
sents.zh: 犯错是允许的，但前提是错得理直气壮。

sents.en: To outsiders, it can look like an elaborate excuse to dress up and show off.
sents.zh: 在外人看来，这可能像是一个煞费苦心的借口，好让人盛装打扮、尽情炫耀。

sents.en: Many have practised for months in front of a mirror, studying the moves of rock legends frame by frame.
sents.zh: 很多人对着镜子练了好几个月，一帧一帧地研究摇滚传奇们的动作。

sents.en: Some insist that air guitar is a genuine art form, one that demands timing, stamina and a total lack of embarrassment.
sents.zh: 有些人坚称空气吉他是一门真正的艺术，它需要节奏感、体力，还要完全不怕难为情。

sents.en: After a single minute on stage, several admit, they are as out of breath as any athlete.
sents.zh: 好几位选手承认，在台上只待一分钟，他们就累得和运动员一样上气不接下气。

sents.en: The festival also wears a cheerful philosophy on its sleeve.
sents.zh: 这个节日还毫不掩饰地亮出一套乐呵呵的哲学。

sents.en: Its organisers like to joke that you cannot hold a weapon while playing air guitar, so if everyone took it up, wars might simply stop.
sents.zh: 主办方爱开玩笑说：弹空气吉他的时候没法拿武器，所以如果人人都玩起来，战争说不定就停了。

sents.en: Nobody pretends this is a serious peace plan, but the slogan captures the spirit of the thing: harmless, generous and slightly absurd.
sents.zh: 没人假装这是认真的和平方案，但这句口号抓住了这项活动的精髓：无害、大方，还有点荒唐。

sents.en: There is something refreshing about a contest in which no one can be accused of having an unfair advantage.
sents.zh: 一场谁也不会被指责占了不公平优势的比赛，自有一种让人耳目一新的地方。

sents.en: No expensive equipment is needed, and a child with enough nerve can, in principle, beat a professional musician.
sents.zh: 不需要昂贵的设备，一个胆子够大的孩子，理论上也能打败专业音乐人。

sents.en: In an age when so much of life is measured, ranked and sold, a world title for doing nothing at all is a small act of rebellion.
sents.zh: 在一个生活里太多东西都要被衡量、排名、拿来卖钱的时代，一项“什么都不做”的世界冠军，算是一种小小的反叛。

sents.en: And unlike most championships, this one leaves its fans with nothing worse than a sore throat.
sents.zh: 而且和大多数锦标赛不同，这一场留给粉丝的，最糟也不过是喊哑了的嗓子。

sents.en: The guitars may be imaginary; the joy, judging by the crowds, is anything but.
sents.zh: 吉他也许是想象出来的；可从观众的热情来看，那份快乐绝不是假的。
